title: Propositions store both the normalized form and the original natural-language statement
Objectives be typed, weighted and permitted to conflict; conflicts be representable
Constraints be typed HARD, SOFT or NON_NEGOTIABLE and be machine-evaluable
Uncertainty carry a type (EPISTEMIC, ALEATORIC, MODEL, MEASUREMENT, SEMANTIC, STRATEGIC) and a distribution where available
Risks carry probability, impact, uncertainty and affected objectives
Assumptions be explicit, attributable and challengeable by the Critic
The data model distinguish fact, claim, assumption, inference, opinion and hypothesis — not only in prompts
The system ingest PDF, DOCX, TXT, Markdown, CSV, XLSX, JSON and HTML
Evidence carry provenance: source, document, page or section, chunk, content hash, retrieved timestamp, source timestamp, trust level
Evidence carry a verification status; LLM-generated text be auto-classified as evidence or fact
Retrieval be hybrid with reranking and be permission-filtered before similarity scoring
Knowledge be namespaced: global, workspace, domain, agent, session, historical
Promotion of session output into durable knowledge require an explicit validation step
A user be able to inject evidence manually, attributed to the human
Retracting a source produce an impact report over every dependent claim
Retrieval failure be recorded as RAG_FAILED, never as a silent empty result

Critiques be typed: EVIDENCE_GAP, LOGICAL_FALLACY, HALLUCINATED_SOURCE, MEASUREMENT_ERROR, MODEL_MISUSE, CONSTRAINT_IGNORED, CONFLICT_OF_INTEREST, ALTERNATIVE_OMITTED, UNCERTAINTY_UNDERSTATED, CAUSAL_OVERCLAIM
Every critique carry severity and a target artifact reference
Agents be able to respond ACCEPT, PARTIALLY_ACCEPT, REJECT_WITH_JUSTIFICATION, REVISE, REQUEST_EVIDENCE, REQUEST_SIMULATION, ABSTAIN
Unresolved critiques appear in the final explanation, never be dropped
The platform preserve dissenting positions, minority reports and unresolved disagreements
Suppressing a minority position be impossible through the API
Consensus be computed by a pluggable ConsensusStrategy behind a stable port
Hard-constraint feasibility be evaluated before any ranking
An infeasible alternative be selectable regardless of score
Outcomes include FULL_CONSENSUS, PARTIAL_CONSENSUS, CONDITIONAL_CONSENSUS, PARETO_SET, NO_CONSENSUS, DEADLOCK, INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, INFEASIBLE
Every result carry a ConsensusExplanation: algorithm, version, formula, weights, thresholds, per-agent contributions, derivation trace
Semantic disagreement be assessed on structured propositions, not string equality
Conflicting objectives produce a Pareto analysis rather than a forced single winner
Every strategy have a formal document in docs/consensus-formalism/ before it is selectable
Consensus support values always be reported with the metric profile, never as a lone number
Agents be able to request a simulation; the coordinator run it as a durable activity
Simulation results carry engine, engine version, spec hash, seed, run count, intervals, sensitivity, validity domain
Simulation output be classified as evidence about the model, not evidence about the world
Untrusted simulation code run through SandboxExecutionProvider with no network and bounded resources
Hard constraints be evaluated by a symbolic reasoner returning SAT, UNSAT or UNKNOWN
Every violation produce a trace: rule, natural-language origin, validation status, inputs, evaluation, verdict
A natural-language constraint become an enforceable rule without recorded validation
Solver UNKNOWN be surfaced as unknown, never as satisfaction or violation
A human be able to pause, resume, inject evidence, amend constraints, modify objectives, request simulation or critique, request another round, reject a recommendation, override an outcome and cancel
Every human action be an event with actor, timestamp and payload
Overrides be labelled as overrides in every downstream view
The system provide four explanation views: executive, expert, formal, machine-readable
A user be able to navigate backward from any recommendation to its original sources
A user be able to navigate forward from any source to every dependent recommendation
The audit trail be append-only and be writable through the application API
Every session produce a reproducibility manifest
Metrics be reported as a multi-dimensional profile; a single aggregate quality score exist
Every metric declare formula, inputs, range, direction, interpretation and caveats
Users be able to define experiments varying agents, strategies, models, prompts, consensus algorithms, retrieval configs and budgets
Experiment runs be reproducible from their manifest, subject to the documented determinism limits
The platform support ablation of any single component
The MARL view expose an observation/action/reward interface and record trajectories, without making MARL a runtime dependency of the MVP
Learning be conservative: promotion of experience into knowledge requires validation, never automatic self-modification
Durability: A session survives any single stateless-service restart with no loss of committed artifacts
Recoverability: RPO ≤ 24 h and RTO ≤ 4 h for the MVP stack, stated honestly rather than implied by replica counts
Determinism: Given the same manifest and mock provider, replay reproduces artifact ids, ordering and consensus output byte-for-byte
Traceability: Any recommendation resolves to its sources within 5 API traversions
Explainability: Every consensus outcome renders a complete explanation without extra user queries
Auditability: 100 % of state-changing actions appear in the ledger; a CI test asserts no mutation path bypasses it
Latency: API reads p95 < 300 ms excluding LLM time; SSE delivery p95 < 1 s after ledger commit
Throughput: ≥ 20 concurrent sessions and ≥ 100 logical agents in flight on the reference dev stack
Cost control: Per-session token and cost ceilings enforced; breach terminates with BUDGET_EXHAUSTED
Security: Least privilege, workspace isolation, no secrets in logs or payloads, OWASP ASVS L2 alignment
